name: Needling Stairs
description: This staircase has springs in each step, which send poisoned needles shooting up through tiny holes in the wood when stepped on. Each step, 6 in total, takes up one 5-foot square.
disable: DC 33 Thievery check (master) on each stair to disable its spring, or deactivate the switch in area C8 to deactivate the whole trap. Cutting the wire on the topmost stair (>DC 35 Thievery check to Disable the Device) that connects the staircase to the control switch prevents the control switch from turning the trap on or off.
reset: If deactivated via the switch, the trap can be reactivated with the switch in area C8.
routine: (1 action) The trap makes a separate poisoned needle Strike against each creature currently on an active step as 1 action. Because it is constantly jabbing needles up through any weight-bearing steps, the trap can also use its Bloody Feet free action to jab at a creature on one of the steps during that creature's turn.

hp.note: Hardness 8 BT 12. to break the spring under the step and make that step safe to stand on

offensiveAbilities.name: First Step
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature ends its movement on one of the stairs

Effect The trap makes a poisoned needle Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bloody Feet
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves onto an active step

Effect The trap makes a poisoned needle Strike against the triggering creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: No MAP
offensiveAbilities.description: The Poisoned Needle Strikes do not apply a MAP.
